record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: Does charge transfer across the interface mediate the interfacial magnetism and the exchange-bias effect in ferromagnet/antiferromagnet van der Waals systems?

evidence.quote: ix. Does charge transfer play a role in mediating the magnetism and the EB effect in FM/AFM vdW systems?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider a heterostructure formed by stacking a two-dimensional ferromagnetic (FM) van der Waals crystal on a two-dimensional antiferromagnetic (AFM) van der Waals crystal, with a sharp, atomically clean interface. The exchange-bias (EB) effect refers to a horizontal shift of the magnetic hysteresis loop of the FM layer along the magnetic-field axis after field cooling through the Néel temperature of the AFM layer, attributed to interfacial exchange coupling between the FM and AFM spin systems. Charge transfer across the interface denotes a net redistribution of electronic charge between the two layers due to differing work functions and orbital hybridization, which can alter local magnetic moments, exchange constants, and magnetic anisotropy at and near the interface.

Determine whether interfacial charge transfer plays a mediating role in establishing the interfacial magnetism and in producing the exchange-bias effect in FM/AFM van der Waals heterostructures. Concretely:
(a) Identify whether the magnitude and sign of the exchange-bias field depend systematically on the amount and direction of interfacial charge transfer.
(b) Establish whether interfacial moments, induced magnetization, or modified exchange couplings arising from charge transfer are necessary or merely incidental to the observed EB.
(c) Provide a quantitative model relating charge-transfer magnitude to the exchange-bias field and to interfacial coercivity enhancement in such 2D vdW FM/AFM systems.
artifact.status_search_result: This is an open research question in 2D van der Waals magnetism. While first-principles studies and experiments on systems such as Fe3GeTe2/CrI3, Fe3GeTe2/MnPS3, and related vdW heterostructures report interfacial charge transfer and proximity-induced magnetic modifications, no consensus quantitative model establishes charge transfer as the mediator of exchange bias. The question is generally posed as an open perspective in the literature on vdW magnetic heterostructures.

status_evidence.title: Exchange bias in van der Waals heterostructures (review context)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists charge-transfer mediation of interfacial magnetism and EB as an open question for FM/AFM vdW systems.
status_evidence.claim: The role of interfacial charge transfer in mediating EB in 2D vdW FM/AFM heterostructures remains an open question.
